title: senna villosa
intro: Senna villosa, commonly known as the hairy senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat a range of health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include the relief of constipation and the treatment of fever and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Senna villosa include its ability to act as a purgative and astringent, which helps to cleanse the digestive system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as sennoside A and sennoside B, which are responsible for its purgative properties.
